backend: MockStack + MockHardwareBridge, wrapped by harness-only settle delay
harness_note: The settle delay is added by this probe, not by the product mock. Without it the mock execute path completes in microseconds and no in-flight window exists. No hardware is opened or contacted.

probes.name: stop while idle
probes.criteria: HTTP 200, stop_latched true, response < 1 s, no active motion

probes.name: stop while execute is in flight
probes.criteria: execute still pending when stop is issued; stop 200 < 1 s; execute 200 with ABORTED; exactly one terminal completion

probes.name: second execute while one is in flight
probes.criteria: second execute is rejected with REJECTED/MOTION_BUSY and never queued; first completes; one backend command

probes.name: client aborts before the late response; idempotent replay
probes.criteria: after a dropped connection the same idempotency key returns the cached terminal result and does not execute a second time

probes.name: lease revoked while execute is in flight
lease expired while execute is in flight
stop/execute race, 30 iterations
probes.criteria: zero 500s, zero COMPLETED after stop, one terminal completion per intent
